parameters.query: INSERT INTO idempotency_keys (key, status) VALUES ($1, 'PROCESSING') ON CONFLICT (key) DO NOTHING RETURNING key;
SELECT status FROM idempotency_keys WHERE key = $1;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'duplicate_unresolved', key_status: $json.status, hint: 'Previously failed events are reprocessed via POST /webhook/dlq-replay' } }}

parameters.query: SELECT rule_id, drifted_key, target_key FROM field_mapping_cache WHERE source_id = $1 AND status = 'active';
UPDATE field_mapping_cache SET hit_count = hit_count + 1 WHERE rule_id IN (SELECT j FROM jsonb_array_elements_text($1::jsonb) AS j) RETURNING rule_id;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'deepseek-flash', temperature: 0, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: $json.systemPrompt }, { role: 'user', content: $json.userPrompt } ] }) }}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO field_mapping_cache (rule_id, source_id, drifted_key, target_key, confidence, sample_value_hash, status) SELECT j->>'rule_id', j->>'source_id', j->>'drifted_key', j->>'target_key', (j->>'confidence')::numeric, j->>'sample_value_hash', 'active' FROM jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb) AS j ON CONFLICT (source_id, drifted_key) DO UPDATE SET target_key = EXCLUDED.target_key, confidence = EXCLUDED.confidence, learned_at = now() WHERE field_mapping_cache.status <> 'revoked' RETURNING rule_id;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ text: 'Schema drift auto-healed', ...$('Heal & Persist Prep').first().json.driftAlert, revoke_hint: 'POST /webhook/mapping-revoke {"rule_id":"<source_id>:<drifted_key>"}' }) }}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO business_leads (source_id, event_id, email, amount, company, plan, raw_payload) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (source_id, event_id) DO UPDATE SET email = EXCLUDED.email, amount = EXCLUDED.amount, company = EXCLUDED.company, plan = EXCLUDED.plan, raw_payload = EXCLUDED.raw_payload RETURNING id;
UPDATE idempotency_keys SET status = 'resolved' WHERE key = $1 RETURNING key;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'stored', self_healed: $('Parse Healer Verdict').isExecuted, event_id: $('Contract Validation').first().json.eventId } }}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO dlq (dlq_id, source_id, idempotency_key, payload, failure_reason, status) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb, $5, 'failed') ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO UPDATE SET failure_reason = EXCLUDED.failure_reason, updated_at = now() RETURNING dlq_id;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ text: 'Event queued to DLQ', dlq_id: $('Write DLQ').first().json.dlq_id, failure_reason: $('Prep DLQ Entry').first().json.failureReason, replay_hint: 'POST /webhook/dlq-replay {"dlq_id":"<uuid>"}' }) }}

parameters.query: UPDATE idempotency_keys SET status = 'failed' WHERE key = $1 RETURNING key;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'queued_to_dlq', dlq_id: $('Write DLQ').first().json.dlq_id, failure_reason: $('Prep DLQ Entry').first().json.failureReason } }}
